crop_map_raster: crop a map raster to a random square region and adjust the xy coordinates accordingly
random_rot90_raster: randomly rotate a map raster by 90 degree increments and update xy coordinates and heading
random_flip_image_raster: randomly flip an image and map raster horizontally or vertically and update coordinates and heading
decompose_rotmat_euler: decompose a camera to world rotation matrix into roll pitch and yaw Euler angles
summarize_data_augmentation_utils: summarize the map location data augmentation utilities for cropping rotation and flipping operations
